scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/webview && npm run build -w packages/extension && npm run build -w packages/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p recorder-ts && go -C recorder-go vet ./...
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w packages/extension
scripts.runshape: npm run --silent build -w packages/cli && node packages/cli/dist/runshape.mjs
